rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18; flat LIGHT backgrounds; store images are on white — cut out (rembg). Whole real product; 1–3 words; 2-D objects next to the product; watermark below content; logo v5 end card; audio LOCKED (narrate.py + mix.sh). Length 45–55 s, HARD CAP 58 s. Draw no Kodak, Apple or Google logos (text names only). Don't call any colour 'secret'.
official_clips: none — the official store page has no product video; no promo video use
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; mint reveal; sky for specs; lavender for tracking; blush #FBE7E2 THE CATCH; Kodak-like marigold accent for prices
assets: assets_sources.md (A–L, official Kodak/Reto store images, 4500×4500 JPEG)
new_objects: keyRing, trackerPing (pin + radar rings), filmSlide (35 mm slide mount + projector beam), coinCell (twist cover + cell swap) — add each to render/kit/OBJECTS.md. Reuse priceTag, screen, ruler, counter, toggle, waves, questionStamp, crossMark, scoreTable.

scenes.anchor: Kodak just made a keychain that shows your photos.
scenes.image: A cut out, centred 60% width, slight swing like hanging from a key ring
scenes.object: new keyRing (metal ring + chain) above the tag; photo on screen fades in like E Ink refresh (flash black/white then colour)
scenes.note: frame 1 must read instantly: tag + PHOTO KEYCHAIN

scenes.object: new trackerPing: map pin with expanding radar rings on the right; small key icon under the pin

scenes.image: D, E, F, G, H fan out in a row (each 22% width), A in front centred
scenes.object: none extra — the row of real designs is the object (product row)

scenes.anchor: It looks like an old film slide,
scenes.object: new filmSlide: classic 35 mm cardboard slide mount + light beam from a projector on the left; morph outline onto I
priceTag '$34.99' swings in right, value rolls up

scenes.anchor: Get this. A tiny color E Ink screen holds twelve photos.
scenes.image: A crop on screen, slow push-in 80%
scenes.object: screen object: 6 ink dots (6 colours) above; ruler '1.54"' along the screen edge; counter 1→12 photos stacking as mini cards

scenes.anchor: It works with Apple Find My, and Google Find Hub.
scenes.object: two generic toggle pills 'Find My' ✓ and 'Find Hub' ✓ (text only, no Apple/Google logos); waves out of the tag; label '30 m' range arc

scenes.anchor: Battery dead? You swap the coin cell yourself.
scenes.object: new coinCell: cover twists open (counter-clockwise), coin cell lifts out and a new one drops in; small 'CR2032' label

scenes.anchor: Here's the catch. It's a blind box, so you don't pick the design.
scenes.image: J (closed blind box) 50% centre, then K small bottom
scenes.object: questionStamp '?' slams on the box; the 8 design tiles shuffle behind it like dice

scenes.anchor: And there's no ultra-wideband, unlike AirTag.
scenes.object: generic round tracker disc (no Apple logo, label 'AirTag' as text) right with a direction arrow; crossMark over 'UWB' under the SlideTag

scenes.anchor: By our score? Sixty-eight out of a hundred.
Spec, if photos matter more than precise finding.
scenes.object: k snaps upright (SPEC end-card motion); pill '✓ photos'

scenes.anchor: Be honest. Would you gamble thirty-five bucks on a mystery box?
scenes.image: A centred 60% exactly as frame 1 + J small behind
scenes.object: priceTag '$34.99' + questionStamp '?' on the blind box
